name: unified-security-cost-optimizer
description: Finds over-provisioned AWS security services without reducing security posture - CloudTrail duplicate or overlapping multi-region trails and redundant management-event delivery, AWS Config recorders collecting unused resource types or high-churn resources, and GuardDuty findings suppressed but not archived plus usage by data source - and generates cost-optimization recommendations that preserve coverage. Read-only and recommend-only. Recommends the AWS Billing and Cost Management MCP and AWS Pricing MCP as augmentation.

trigger.description: Runs weekly on THU at 05:00 UTC
